_preservation.why_this_matters: Three pricing eras are visible in these rows and each is a decision otherwise reconstructable only from commit messages. THE 15% ERA (rows 1-8, 8 and 14 July): commission 15%, DEDUCTED from the pandit, with 18% GST computed on the fee and shown to the customer as a separate line. THE RATE CUT (commit 0be83f5, 15 July, 'commission is ONE number (10%)') is why row 9 alone carries 10%. THE MODEL-A ERA closes with row 9 (HPJ-2026-19502, 20 July, Razorpay order_TFefNl2TrhDM3E): dakshina 2100, fee 210, grandTotal 2100, payout 1890 — the customer was NOT charged the fee on top and the pandit DID absorb it. Ruling B (commit 3548679, 22 July) reversed that two days later, so row 9 is the last and only production artefact of the deducted model. travelCost is 0 on all nine, which is what downgrades the fabricated-travel finding from a realised loss to a loaded gun.

_double_fee_trace_ANSWERED.question: Could any code version produce rows 1-8's composition — fee charged ON TOP and ALSO deducted?
_double_fee_trace_ANSWERED.answer: The composition is real and a code version DID implement it, but these particular rows are HAND-WRITTEN SEED LITERALS, not that code's output.
_double_fee_trace_ANSWERED.the_code: Before commit f803f10 (16 July) services/api/src/utils/pricing.ts computed grandTotal = dakshina + travel + food + accommodation + platformFee + travelServiceFee + platformFeeGst + travelServiceFeeGst, AND panditPayout = dakshina - platformFee + pass-throughs. Fee on top AND deducted. f803f10's own message names it: 'The old model double-charged: +10% on the customer AND -10% from the pandit.'
_double_fee_trace_ANSWERED.why_the_rows_are_literals_not_output: packages/db/prisma/seed.ts:284 writes `dakshinaAmount: 3100, platformFee: 465, platformFeeGst: 83, grandTotal: 3648` as literals. The 1-rupee rounding proves authorship: the real calculateGst used Math.round(465 * 0.18) = Math.round(83.7) = 84, which would give grandTotal 3649. The stored value is 83/3648. A human truncated; the function would have rounded up.
_double_fee_trace_ANSWERED.correction_recorded: An earlier inference in this campaign ran the arithmetic, saw it agree with the pre-16-July model, and was about to name that code as the producer. Checking seed.ts reversed it. CAPABILITY != PATH: arithmetic agreement is not a producing path.
